lead: A command palette: a search box over a list of commands ranked by how well they match, driven by data (`items`: commands, groups, icons, shortcut hints, aliases). Focus always stays in the input and the list is read the combobox way. `Command` is the inline version, `CommandDialog` the pop-up one (it can bind a global hotkey). Keyboard: ↑ ↓ move (wrapping at the ends, skipping disabled items), Home / End, Enter runs.

dialog.title: Dialog and hotkey
dialog.description: `hotkey="mod+j"` toggles it globally (not `mod+k` here, which the docs site's own search uses). Opening moves focus into the input, Esc closes it, and focus then returns to the button.

search.title: Search and keywords
search.description: Try typing add, name, dash or nf: results rank as "exact > prefix > word start > contains > alias > letters in order"; with no result, `emptyText` shows.
search.label: Search demo

api.title: API Reference
api.entries: Each entry of `items` is a command `{ key, label, icon?, shortcut?, keywords?, disabled?, onSelect? }` or a group `{ type: "group", key, label, items }`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root, the input row (with the search icon) and the input (`role=combobox`)
styling.list: The list (`role=listbox`), a group (`role=group`) and its title
styling.dialog: The backdrop and dialog of the pop-up version (`data-starting-style` / `data-ending-style`)
